dataset_name: MOPITT Derived CO (Thermal + Near Infrared Radiances) Monthly Global Gridded L3
download_mechanism: CMR Granule Search + Authenticated HTTPS / earthaccess
data_limitations: Cloud-free scenes only; TIR/NIR joint retrievals require sunlit daytime conditions over land for NIR sensitivity.
scientific_justification: Highest multi-decade satellite record of surface/column CO concentration from Terra (2000–2025).

dataset_name: MERRA-2 tavgM_2d_chm_Nx: 2D Monthly Mean Atmospheric Chemistry
data_limitations: Reanalysis model output; reflects prior emission inventories coupled with chemistry transport.
scientific_justification: Gap-free 1980–present context extending prior to Terra MOPITT launch.

dataset_name: MERRA-2 tavgM_2d_aer_Nx: Black Carbon Surface Mass
data_limitations: AOD assimilation constrains total column extinction rather than speciated BC fractions directly.
scientific_justification: Standard global assimilated aerosol reanalysis used in South Asian black carbon studies.

dataset_name: MERRA-2 tavgM_2d_aer_Nx: Organic Carbon Surface Mass
data_limitations: Speciation follows GOCART optical properties and emissions.
scientific_justification: Captures seasonal crop-residue burning and biofuel OC trends across India.

dataset_name: MERRA-2 tavgM_2d_aer_Nx: Sulfate Surface Mass
data_limitations: Precursor SO2 chemistry relies on inventory updates.
scientific_justification: Continuous global monthly sulfate aerosol field spanning pre- and post-industrial regulation periods.

dataset_name: MODIS/Terra Aerosol Cloud Water Vapor Ozone Monthly L3 Global 1Deg CMG
download_mechanism: CMR Granule Search + Authenticated HTTPS / OPeNDAP
data_limitations: Monsoon cloud cover reduces monthly clear-sky sampling frequency; AOD != PM2.5.
scientific_justification: Dark Target + Deep Blue merged retrieval works over both vegetated belts and bright arid India.

dataset_name: MERRA-2 Total Aerosol Extinction AOT (550 nm)
data_limitations: Pre-2000 years lack MODIS AOD assimilation.
scientific_justification: Gap-free cloud-filled AOD benchmark complementing MODIS MOD08_M3.

dataset_name: AIRS/Aqua L3 Monthly Standard Physical Retrieval (CH4 & Relative Humidity)
data_limitations: Thermal IR sounder peaks in mid-to-upper troposphere (~300–500 hPa), lower sensitivity in boundary layer.
scientific_justification: 22+ year consistent satellite CH4 record.

dataset_name: Copernicus CAMS Global Greenhouse Gas Reanalysis (EGG4) Monthly CH4
data_limitations: EGG4 archive currently ends in December 2020.
scientific_justification: Provides vertical profile levels (surface to upper troposphere) complementing AIRS.

dataset_name: MERRA-2 tavgM_2d_slv_Nx: Single-Level Diagnostics (T2M, WIND, QV2M)
data_limitations: 0.5° grid averages elevation gradients in Himalayan and Western Ghats terrain.
scientific_justification: Homogenized 1980–present atmospheric assimilation.

dataset_name: NASA POWER Agroclimatology Monthly Gridded/Regional API
scientific_variable: 2-m Temperature / Precipitation / Wind / Humidity / Soil Wetness
download_mechanism: NASA POWER Regional NetCDF REST API
data_limitations: Regional NetCDF requests are capped at a 10°×10° bounding box per call; tiles can be mosaicked for India.
scientific_justification: Zero-auth live NetCDF & JSON access to MERRA-2 meteorology and model hydrology.

dataset_name: ERA5 Monthly Averaged Data on Single Levels (Copernicus CDS)
download_mechanism: CDS API (cdsapi) with server-side area/time subsetting
data_limitations: Requires valid Copernicus CDS account & license acceptance.
scientific_justification: Finer 0.25° global climate reanalysis benchmark since 1940.

dataset_name: MODIS/Terra Land Surface Temperature/Emissivity Monthly L3 Global 0.05Deg CMG
download_mechanism: AppEEARS Area Task (GeoTIFF/NetCDF) or CMR LPCLOUD HTTPS
data_limitations: Clear-sky bias (warm bias vs all-sky temperatures during monsoon clouds).
scientific_justification: Authoritative 0.05° multi-decade thermal IR skin temperature product.

dataset_name: GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 1 month 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree V07
download_mechanism: GES DISC OPeNDAP (NetCDF subset) / CMR HTTPS
data_limitations: 3.5-month Final Run latency; high-elevation Himalayan snowfall uncertainty.
scientific_justification: 0.1° gauge-calibrated multi-satellite precipitation standard across India since 1998.

dataset_name: MERRA-2 tavgM_2d_flx_Nx: Bias-Corrected Total Precipitation
data_limitations: Coarser 0.5° resolution than GPM IMERG (0.1°).
scientific_justification: Matches NASA POWER PRECTOTCORR series used in TerraShift case studies.

dataset_name: MERRA-2 tavgM_2d_slv_Nx: 10-m Wind Components & Speed
data_limitations: Vector-averaged monthly wind components differ slightly from scalar mean speed.
scientific_justification: Complete 1980–present wind climatology for monsoon onset and coastal wind analysis.

dataset_name: MERRA-2 tavgM_2d_slv_Nx: 2-m Specific Humidity
data_limitations: Assimilated surface moisture sensitivity in sparse synoptic regions.
scientific_justification: Tracks atmospheric moisture capacity changes under Clausius-Clapeyron warming.

dataset_name: AIRS/Aqua L3 Monthly Surface Relative Humidity
data_limitations: Satellite IR retrieval fails under optically thick clouds.
scientific_justification: Direct satellite sounder humidity profile.

dataset_name: SMAP Enhanced L3 Radiometer Global and Northern Hemisphere Daily 9 km EASE-Grid Soil Moisture
download_mechanism: CMR Granule Search + NSIDC Authenticated HTTPS / AppEEARS
data_limitations: Starts March 2015; Radio Frequency Interference (RFI) and dense forest canopy degrade retrievals.
scientific_justification: Gold-standard L-band microwave surface soil moisture (0–5 cm) at 9 km resolution.

dataset_name: GLDAS Noah Land Surface Model L4 Monthly 0.25 x 0.25 degree V2.1 (Soil Moisture)
data_limitations: Unassimilated land-surface model; heavy groundwater pumping for irrigation in NW India is not explicitly simulated.
scientific_justification: 0.25° physically consistent soil moisture column closing water and energy budgets.

dataset_name: MERRA-2 tavgM_2d_lnd_Nx: Root-Zone Soil Wetness
data_limitations: Model-derived wetness fraction (relative to soil porosity).
scientific_justification: 1980–present consistency matching TerraShift case files.

dataset_name: GLDAS Noah Land Surface Model L4 Monthly 0.25 degree V2.1 (Runoff)
data_limitations: Reservoir regulation and inter-basin canals are not routed automatically.
scientific_justification: Separates fast storm runoff from baseflow across river basins.

dataset_name: GLDAS Noah Land Surface Model L4 Monthly 0.25 degree V2.1 (Evapotranspiration)
data_limitations: Does not ingest canal irrigation water additions in Punjab/Haryana unless forced.
scientific_justification: Standard energy-balance actual ET dataset from 2000–present.

dataset_name: MODIS/Terra Vegetation Indices Monthly L3 Global 0.05Deg CMG (NDVI)
quality_flags: CMG 0.05 Deg Monthly VI Quality;CMG 0.05 Deg Monthly Pixel Reliability
data_limitations: Saturates at high LAI (>4) and sensitive to residual monsoon cloud contamination.
scientific_justification: 25-year global 0.05° vegetation greenness standard.

dataset_name: MODIS/Terra Vegetation Indices Monthly L3 Global 0.05Deg CMG (EVI)
quality_flags: CMG 0.05 Deg Monthly VI Quality;CMG 0.05 Deg Monthly Pixel Reliability
data_limitations: Requires aerosol/blue-band quality filtering; cloud shadows drop EVI.
scientific_justification: Improves sensitivity over dense humid forests (Western Ghats, Northeast India).

dataset_name: MODIS/Terra Gross Primary Productivity Gap-Filled 8-Day L4 Global 500m SIN Grid
data_limitations: Crops under intensive fertilization can exceed biome-specific Light Use Efficiency assumptions.
scientific_justification: Directly quantifies photosynthetic carbon assimilation beyond spectral greenness indices.
